title: C# async/await & Task.Run Recipe — Companion Resources
title_es: Receta C# async/await y Task.Run — Recursos complementarios
description: Runnable C# concurrency examples: Task.WhenAll fan-out, WhenAny with proper cancellation, Channels producer-consumer with backpressure, Parallel.ForEachAsync and SemaphoreSlim bounded parallelism, and IAsyncEnumerable async streams.
description_es: Ejemplos ejecutables de concurrencia en C#: fan-out con Task.WhenAll, WhenAny con cancelación correcta, productor-consumidor con Channels y backpressure, paralelismo acotado con Parallel.ForEachAsync y SemaphoreSlim, y streams async con IAsyncEnumerable.
